# FTB Quests task and reward types

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs - edit versions.mjs, not this file -->

A type the target version does not register is **not an error in game**: the loader replaces it with a
Custom task/reward titled `Unknown type: <id>`, which never completes and is saved back as
`type: "custom"`, losing the original spelling. Check the availability column before writing quest
data for an old pack, or pass `--ftbq <ver>` to the validator and let `task-type-unknown` /
`reward-type-unknown` catch it.

Conversely, a task/reward **without** a `type` field is defaulted to `item` - for a task that means it
completes on the first item pickup, which is why the validator reports it as an error.

`id` and `type` are written by every task and reward compound; they are not repeated in the field columns.
Required fields are the ones FTB Quests reads unconditionally; optional fields only appear when set.

## Tasks

| task | 1.16 | 1.18 | 1.19 | 1.20.1 | 1.21.1 | required | optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `item` | `count`, `weak_nbt_match`, `match_nbt`, `match_components`, `consume_items`, `only_from_crafting`, `task_screen_only` |
| `custom` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | none | `title`, `description` |
| `xp` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `value` | `points` |
| `dimension` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `dimension` | none |
| `stat` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `stat`, `value` | none |
| `kill` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `entity`, `value` | `custom_name`, `nbt_filter`, `entityTypeTag` |
| `location` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `dimension` | `ignore_dimension` |
| `checkmark` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | none | `title` |
| `advancement` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `advancement` | `criterion` |
| `observation` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `observe_type`, `to_observe` | `timer` |
| `biome` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `biome` | none |
| `structure` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `structure` | none |
| `gamestage` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `stage` | `team_stage` |
| `fluid` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `fluid` | `amount`, `nbt` |
| `forge_energy` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | `value` | `max_input` |
| `interaction` | - | - | - | - | yes | `interaction_type`, `to_interact` | none |

- `forge_energy`: Forge/NeoForge only (Fabric packs do not register it)

## Fields that older versions drop

These keys exist only from the listed version on. Writing them into an older pack is silently ignored,
which is how a quest ends up "not behaving as written" after a downgrade or a copy from a newer pack.

| key | since |
|---|---|
| `chapter.autofocus_id` | 1.19 |
| `chapter.default_repeatable_quest` | 1.20.1 |
| `chapter.hide_quest_details_until_startable` | 1.21.1 |
| `chapter.hide_quest_until_deps_visible` | 1.21.1 |
| `chapter.hide_quest_until_deps_complete` | 1.21.1 |
| `chapter.hide_text_until_complete` | 1.16 |
| `quest.dep_control_pts` | 1.21.1 |
| `quest.preset` | 1.21.1 |
| `quest.min_required_dependencies` | 1.16 |
| `quest.hide_dependent_lines` | 1.19 |
| `quest.hide_lock_icon` | 1.20.1 |
| `quest.icon_scale` | 1.20.1 |
| `quest.max_completable_dependents` | 1.20.1 |
| `quest.repeat_cooldown` | 1.20.1 |
| `quest.invisible_until_tasks` | 1.18 |
| `quest.progression_mode` | 1.18 |
| `quest.can_repeat` | 1.18 |
| `quest.ignore_reward_blocking` | 1.18 |
| `data.show_lock_icons` | 1.21.1 |
| `data.drop_book_on_death` | 1.20.1 |
| `data.hide_excluded_quests` | 1.20.1 |
| `data.verify_on_load` | 1.21.1 |
| `data.presets` | 1.21.1 |
